authorship: The generator independently constructs a 2 by 2 RGB pixel array and PSD header and section lengths, and for the metadata variant authors TIFF/IFD0 Artist, XMP CreatorTool and IPTC keyword values; no external images, samples, code, metadata or camera data were used.
limitations: PSD v1 flat uncompressed RGB; one empty-resource file and one EXIF/XMP/IPTC resource file. ICC, thumbnail, PSB, color management, layered content, complete conformance, patent clearance and format support are not established.
